name: Gift Cards
title: Gift Cards: operator and guest paths and what can go wrong

BANDS.s: Ops switches gift cards on for the location and enters the eCard Systems processor credentials that every balance movement depends on
Amount rules, PIN rules, design categories and templates, and the links the operator shares with guests
Ordering physical cards from eCard Systems, the stock import webhook, and uploading balances from a previous gift card system

BANDS.t: Guest buys a digital card online
BANDS.s: The online gift card page: design, amount, recipient, delivery method and send time, up to the payment link
Adyen payment, the webhook that creates and loads the card on eCard Systems, the purchase record, and the email or text to the recipient
The recipient opens the email or text and links the card to a phone number

BANDS.t: Sell and reload cards at POS
BANDS.s: Create a physical purchase, reload an active card or sell a digital card on its own ticket.
Guest or staff check what is left on a card, by card number and PIN or by phone number
Paying with a gift card on POS (with the CFD), online ordering and Kiosk, including partial payment and migrated cards
Refunds to a gift card, reloads, reversing a gift card sale, and cards that keep a balance indefinitely
The Gift Cards overview figures, card list, guest profile view and how they reconcile with the Merchant and sales reports

NODES.d: A restaurant signs up for gift cards. Gift cards run on eCard Systems (a third-party card processor): it generates digital card numbers and PINs, holds the real balance and processes every load, sale and void. AIO keeps a copy of each card and its balance.
e: Restaurant is sold gift cards before an eCard Systems account exists for the location
Go-live delayed, operator sees a disabled module
No onboarding checklist covering credentials, settings, templates and the website page

NODES.t: Enable gift cards and add credentials
NODES.d: In the Ops dashboard location settings, the gift cards toggle is switched on and two credential pairs are entered: gateway (used for loads, sales, balances and PIN checks) and digital (used to create new digital cards). Blank values are saved as empty and the host is taken from server configuration. The save button is disabled while the toggle is on and any of the four fields is empty.
e: Gateway and digital credentials swapped or mistyped; nothing tests them on save
Every purchase, load and redemption fails at run time
Credentials of another location or tenant pasted in
Balances loaded to or deducted from the wrong merchant account
Processor credentials are exposed during location setup
Payment partner account confidentiality at risk
Changing credentials while cards exist leaves old cards on the previous account
Toggle switched off with balances outstanding; no warning
Guests cannot spend money they paid for

NODES.d: Web Dash treats gift cards as enabled only when the gift cards toggle is on and all six credential values (gateway and digital host, username, password) are present. Otherwise the Overview and Configure pages show a Feature not enabled screen.
e: Module status is cached; after Ops saves credentials the page still shows Feature not enabled until the cache clears
Status only checks values exist, not that they work
Module shows enabled with broken credentials
POS, Kiosk and online ordering read their own flags, so gift cards can appear on a device while Web Dash says disabled, or the reverse

NODES.d: Configure minimum and maximum amounts and up to five preset denominations. The service checks the order of the bounds and that the presets fall inside them. The settings request also enforces the platform maximum.
e: Typed preset not added because Enter was not pressed; the form blocks save with a hint but operators miss it
An invalid preset or an amount beyond the configured cap is saved
Raising the minimum does not affect drafts already created online at the old amount
Card sold below the new minimum
Maximum is applied per card on POS sales but the online purchase is not checked against it on the server
Cards above the maximum can be bought
Two managers editing settings at once, last save wins with no warning

NODES.d: Configure independent PIN settings for online ordering, POS and Kiosk. Kiosk defaults to off where no setting exists. Both Kiosk validation and the final gift card payment read the restaurant setting.
e: Inadequate verification allows an unintended person to spend a card
Setting change not picked up by POS until it refreshes its settings
A guest with a physical card cannot locate the PIN required at checkout
Payment pauses until the guest can verify the card or use another tender
Balance access does not consistently enforce the configured verification policy
Card information disclosed to the wrong person

NODES.d: Template categories (for example Birthday, Thank you) group the card designs guests choose from. Names are trimmed and must be unique per location, with a fixed maximum number of categories. A category cannot be deleted while an active template uses it.
e: Category limit reached with a message written for guest categories
Empty category (all its templates deleted) still listed on the website gift card section
Guest sees a category with no designs
Renaming a category is not reflected on purchase pages until caches expire

NODES.d: Templates are uploaded, cropped to 16:9 and assigned to a category. A template is soft-deleted; deletion is blocked while an active card uses it. Online ordering only shows categories that have at least one active template, and with none the gift card page returns no gift cards.
e: No template uploaded, so the online gift card page has nothing to sell and the website gift card page errors
Delete check only counts cards in active status, not cards paid and waiting for the recipient
Pending gift email shows a missing design
Edit upload fails silently and the old image is saved under the new category
Large or wrong-format images accepted and look poor on email and phone

NODES.d: Promote Your Program shows two copyable links: the gift card webpage on the restaurant website (only when a website domain exists, otherwise Site not setup yet) and the gift card purchase link on online ordering.
e: Website link points to a gift cards page that does not exist or was never published, giving a 404
Guests cannot buy from the website
Website link uses the temporary staging domain when the custom domain certificate is not valid
Guests sent to a staging URL
Purchase link built from aliases; changing the restaurant alias breaks links already printed or shared

NODES.d: Physical Cards opens the eCard Systems AIO store with a location id made of environment, tenant and restaurant ids; Accessories opens the general store. Cards are printed and shipped by eCard Systems.
e: Location id built with the wrong environment code, so cards are tied to another environment
Stock never arrives in the live account
Operator of a multi-location tenant orders while on the wrong location
Cards stocked at the wrong store
No order status in Web Dash

NODES.d: The processor sends a stock import request for the restaurant. AIO validates the request and rejects a previously processed job.
e: Sensitive processor authentication material appears in operational records
Clock drift beyond 5 minutes rejects valid webhooks
CSV missing Account ID or Card Numbers headers rejects the whole file
Callback token not configured, so eCard Systems is never told the result

NODES.d: Cards are queued in batches; a background job encrypts each number, stores its hash and a purchase URL (used for the QR on the card) as In stock, and on the last batch uploads an output CSV and calls back. Any insert error (usually a duplicate number) deletes every row of the job and reports failure.
e: One duplicate card number fails and deletes the whole shipment
Batches processed out of order; an earlier error stored in the cache is missed and a later batch reports success
Partial stock, wrong status sent back
Progress counters expire before a large job finishes
Purchase URL built from aliases that later change
QR codes on printed cards break

NODES.d: Overview, menu, Import: the operator selects the previous platform and uploads an .xls, .xlsx or .csv file up to 5MB with that platform's columns (card number and balance). Progress is polled until done.
e: Previous platform not in the list, or its export uses different column names
Re-uploading a file that was already imported fails every row as already existing, read as a broken import
Operator and support think cards were lost
Upload is per location; cards valid at all stores of the old system are tied to one location
File exceeds 5MB for large card books
Import must be split by hand
Upload holds full card numbers; no audit of who imported what

NODES.d: Every row needs a card number and a non-negative numeric balance (currency symbols stripped), with no duplicates in the file or against cards already migrated for that location. If any row fails, nothing is imported and a CSV report with a reason per row is returned.
e: Balances with thousands separators or text are misread after stripping characters
Card numbers stored as numbers in Excel lose leading zeros or switch to scientific notation
Imported number does not match the physical card
Zero-balance cards are accepted and fill the list
One bad row blocks thousands of good ones

NODES.d: Valid rows are queued in batches of 100 and saved as active migrated cards for the location. Migrated cards exist only in AIO, not on eCard Systems, so they cannot be charged directly; their balance is used by transferring it to a new physical card on POS.
e: Progress counters are cleared by the status poll when done; a second import at the same location overwrites the first one's progress
Rows failing on save are listed in an error file the operator is never shown in the dialog
Expiry date column exists but is never filled or enforced
Imported Balance on the Overview only counts cards once transferred, not the outstanding migrated total

NODES.d: The guest opens the online ordering gift card page (or the website gift card section) for the restaurant alias. It loads categories with active designs and the amount settings. With no designs it reports that no gift cards were found.
e: Website gift cards page returns 404 for digital gift cards
Page loads without settings when none were saved, so amount entry has no limits
Restaurant alias not found for a renamed location

NODES.d: The guest picks a design in a category, then a preset or a custom amount between the minimum and maximum, and enters sender name, email and phone.
e: A purchase draft accepts an amount outside the restaurant limits
Cards outside the rules, including zero or negative
Decimal amounts round differently between the page, the charge and the load
Card value differs from amount paid by cents
Sender phone or email mistyped; no confirmation step
Page not accessible with a screen reader (design picker, amount chips)

NODES.d: Myself: the card is delivered to the purchaser and becomes active when paid. Someone else: recipient details are required and the card stays paid but not active until the recipient links it.
e: Switching from Someone else to Myself keeps old recipient data in the update call
Card sent to an earlier recipient
Gift cards that are paid but never linked are excluded from phone lookups and some redemption checks

NODES.d: Recipient name, delivery method (Send as email or Send as text) with the matching address or phone, and an optional personal message.
e: Wrong recipient email or phone; there is no way for the guest or operator to resend or change it after payment
Card value delivered to a stranger
Personal message not filtered; abusive text sent under the restaurant name
Text delivery to a number that has opted out of the sending service

NODES.d: On the payment screen: Send now, or Schedule for later with a date and time. The choice is saved on the draft card, converted to UTC, just before payment is submitted.
e: Guest time zone versus restaurant time zone not shown; the card arrives at the wrong hour
Birthday card arrives a day early or late
Schedule save fails but payment goes ahead, so the card is sent immediately
Past date allowed and silently treated as Send now

NODES.d: A draft card record (inactive, balance equal to the amount) is created and a one-hour token for the payment page is issued. The payment page validates the token and adds any online convenience fee configured for the location.
e: A purchase draft can be changed by someone other than its intended purchaser
Abandoned drafts accumulate with personal data and no clean-up
Token expires after one hour while the guest is still on the page
Convenience fee shown on the page differs from what is charged

NODES.d: The guest pays by card through Adyen (online, 3D Secure where required). Success triggers the payment webhook carrying the draft card id, business and restaurant ids, and reload flags.
e: Payment captured but the webhook fails or is lost; no card is issued and no retry alert reaches the restaurant
Guest double-submits and pays twice for one draft
Missing restaurant or business id in the webhook is logged and dropped

NODES.d: The webhook skips payments already processed, then asks eCard Systems for the next virtual account number and PIN using the digital credentials. Number and PIN are encrypted, a lookup hash and a QR image (stored in S3) are created and saved on the card.
e: eCard Systems down or credentials wrong: payment kept, card never created
Duplicate webhook processed in parallel before the first is recorded, issuing two cards for one payment
A card image is visible outside its intended recipient group

NODES.d: The paid amount is loaded onto the new card on eCard Systems with the gateway credentials. This call is outside the database transaction.
e: Load succeeds on eCard Systems but a later step fails and the database rolls back; the card holds value AIO has no record of
Load fails after the number was saved; card shows the full balance in AIO but zero on eCard Systems
Digital and gateway credentials belong to different eCard accounts, so the issued card cannot be loaded

NODES.t: Record the online purchase and link the guest
NODES.d: The payment webhook creates a gift card ticket and movement record for an online purchase or reload and associates the payment. After commit it emits the settled ticket event. A gift and a self-purchase can appear under different guest profiles.
e: Purchase payment has no ticket and no restaurant on the card record, so reports that filter by restaurant drop it
Sale missing from the Merchant report
Commit happens before the remaining steps; a failure afterwards leaves a paid card with no webhook record
Duplicate rows written for one purchase
Promotions consent stored from a pre-ticked or unclear box
A settled gift card ticket is searched for among dining orders
Support cannot find the receipt for a successful purchase

NODES.d: The purchaser receives a receipt showing the masked card number, recipient details, amount and delivery status.
e: The gift card receipt goes to the wrong email address
Receipt lost, personal data to a stranger
A receipt is sent to an unverified destination
Total charged shows the card amount, not the amount including convenience fee
Receipt does not match the bank statement

NODES.d: For new purchases (not reloads) the saved send time is read back as UTC. A time in the future schedules the message; empty or past sends immediately. The delivery method chooses email or text.
e: Time read back in the server's local zone shifts the schedule by hours
Card delivered at the wrong time
Delivery method missing on older drafts defaults to email even when a phone was given
Card goes to an empty email

NODES.t: Card sent by email or text
NODES.d: Email: header, design, amount, full card number, PIN, QR, personal message, a link to activate (for gifts) and to link the card to a phone. Text: amount, message, full card number, PIN, link to link with phone, redeem link and Reply with STOP to opt out, sent through the post-order Twilio service. Send errors are logged only.
e: Queue or provider failure is swallowed; the guest is told the card was sent
Full card number and PIN in plain email and text
Anyone who sees the message can spend the card
Text sent from the order-ready messaging service, not a registered gift card sender
Restaurant logo or social links missing when Brand Book is not set
No resend option in Web Dash or for the guest

NODES.d: A scheduled email or text is held by the scheduler (event named after the environment, business and card) and sent at the chosen time.
e: Schedule cannot be changed or cancelled after payment
Scheduler failure only logged; card never delivered
Restaurant offboarded before the send date

NODES.d: The recipient sees the design, amount and card details. The activate link carries a signed token; opening it shows the card with its live balance from eCard Systems.
e: Activate token expires before the recipient opens it
Balance lookup on eCard Systems fails and the page errors instead of showing the card
Recipient thinks the gift is broken
Forwarded message gives a second person full control of the card

NODES.d: The recipient verifies the phone through the link flow. An expired verification code can be resent. After linking, the gifted card belongs in the recipient profile and can be looked up on supported surfaces.
e: A card is assigned to someone other than the verified recipient
Guest loses access to stored value
Country code stored inconsistently (+1 or none), so later phone lookups miss the card
Card not found at POS or Kiosk
Unlinked gifts stay in paid status and some channels refuse them

NODES.d: On POS the staff member opens the current gift card ticket, a separate ticket type kept per employee and location. An unpaid ticket is reused, and items whose card is no longer in stock are dropped. Ticket numbers come from the same sequence as orders.
e: Duplicate gift card tickets created for one sale
Ticket sequence failure blocks the sale with a payment error message
Employee not linked to the location cannot open a ticket

NODES.t: Select physical cards or reload items
NODES.d: For a new physical sale, select in-stock cards at the restaurant and set their amounts. An existing eligible active card can be added as a reload. A digital purchase uses its own ticket and cannot share it with a physical purchase or reload.
e: A cashier expects to sell an already active card as new stock
The register offers a reload for that card
A card is stocked against a different restaurant from the selling register
The cashier cannot sell that card from the current stock
A report compares discounted proceeds with face value without showing the discount
The operator cannot explain the difference between cash collected and value loaded
The register has no valid minimum and maximum when a cashier enters a load amount
The amount can pass the screen check and still need a server decision

NODES.d: Take the net sale amount after any discount by card, cash, another supported tender or gift card. For payment using another gift card, its balance must cover the purchase on this POS flow. If it falls short, the register offers a change of payment method. Confirm the tender outcome before retrying a payment.
e: Terminal times out and the webhook arrives later; staff charge again
Webhook marks partial paid when the amount differs from the gross total even though a discount was applied
A gift card used to buy another gift card is counted as new cash in a reconciliation

NODES.d: Fulfil each eligible purchase or reload, update the card and record a movement against its gift card ticket item. If the provider and AIO disagree on a partially completed ticket, reconcile the individual lines before retrying.
e: Some cards load and others fail after the ticket is already marked paid
Guest paid for a card with no value
Void after a failed database update also fails, logged as critical only
Card holds value AIO does not record
A physical card sale is recorded without a link to the buyer
Staff cannot find the card by the buyer's phone number alone

NODES.d: Guests and staff can check a balance through the supported online, POS and kiosk flows. Confirm identity, masking and verification for each channel.
e: Lookup error wording discloses sensitive verification details
Balance lookup reveals another guest card record
A verification credential is exposed during balance enquiry
Repeated unsuccessful balance checks do not trigger effective protection
The POS card lookup shows the original amount when the returned balance is zero and the original amount is positive
Staff can quote value that has already been spent

NODES.d: Balance validation can query eCard Systems. The dashboard and guest profile project stored balances and transactions. After a payment or provider failure, compare the same card and point in time before treating the values as inconsistent.
e: AIO copy stale after a failed sync, so dashboards and the guest profile disagree with the real balance
Balance shown on one device is not refreshed for the next transaction
eCard Systems slow or down blocks every lookup with a generic error

NODES.t: Scan or key in card on POS
NODES.d: At payment, staff choose gift card and scan or type the number. POS validates the card against active digital and physical cards (and, outside redemption, stock and migrated cards) and shows the balance.
e: Scan shows POS data sync in progress and the gift card payment cannot be applied
Guest cannot pay with the card
Staff try to spend an imported card while it still requires a balance transfer
The guest must complete the transfer before paying
The card number exceeds the 19 digits accepted by manual entry
Staff cannot enter the full number in the payment dialog
Paid but unlinked gift cards are not active and are refused

NODES.d: When the POS PIN setting is on, the guest can enter the gift card PIN on the customer display or at the register. A failed check keeps the payment from advancing. The guest can retry the PIN on the same card.
e: A verification failure gives the guest too little information to distinguish a wrong PIN from a service problem
The guest retries without knowing whether to use another tender
Repeated failed verification attempts are not handled according to the restaurant's policy
The restaurant cannot rely on consistent payment verification

NODES.d: POS submits the chosen amount and any tip for processing. Check the amount charged to the card, the payment posted to the ticket and the remaining bill together. A ticket-level check does not establish the balance available to a different ticket.
e: Sale succeeds on eCard Systems but the payment save then fails and rolls back; the card is debited with no payment
The POS balance displayed after payment is calculated from the previous balance and tip and differs from the posted card balance
The guest sees an incorrect amount left on the card
Two devices charging the same card at once both pass the balance check
Charge sent with the location's own credentials; a card issued under a sister location's account is declined

NODES.d: The customer-facing display shows the gift card amount applied, the remaining balance and any tip prompt.
e: CFD shows the previous gift card amount on the next card transaction
Add Tip text too small on gift card and tender payments
The guest selects a gift card tip but the payment flow omits it or fails to offer the configured prompt
Staff must reconcile the missing tip

NODES.t: Did the gift card payment settle the order?
NODES.d: For a restaurant order, staff can apply the full amount due or a smaller amount from the gift card. A remaining amount requires another payment. A gift card purchase paid with another gift card follows a separate full-coverage rule.
e: The register leaves staff unsure whether a partially paid ticket still needs payment
Staff can miss the amount still due
The payment breakdown and ticket status disagree when one cent remains
Staff cannot tell whether the ticket is settled
Deals and loyalty change the total after the card was charged

NODES.d: Staff take the rest by card, cash, tender or another gift card. Several gift cards can be applied one after another.
e: Staff close the ticket without collecting the remainder because the screen looks complete
Receipt lists only one gift card when several were used
Guest cannot see each card's balance
A second tender is voided and the ticket no longer distinguishes it from the gift card payment already applied
Staff cannot reconcile the remaining bill

NODES.d: At online checkout the guest applies a linked card or enters number and PIN. The amount covered is stored on the cart and the rest is paid by card through Adyen; if the card covers everything the order goes through the zero-dollar path.
e: Card balance on the cart is the AIO copy, not checked live, so a card spent in store since is accepted
Tip on an order fully paid by gift card is folded into the total differently from POS
Removing the card does not clear the applied amount on the cart

NODES.d: After Adyen confirms the card part (or immediately for zero-dollar orders), the gift card amount is charged on eCard Systems and the AIO balance is reduced with half-up rounding.
e: Card part captured but the gift card sale fails afterwards; order sent to the kitchen with part unpaid
AIO balance reduced even when the eCard sale was not attempted because the card record was missing
Rounding differs from eCard Systems by a cent

NODES.d: The Kiosk lookup and validation services resolve eligible cards. The final payment checks the card, current cart and restaurant PIN policy again. The payment service has separate handling for full gift card payment and payment with a second tender.
e: The card is valid at lookup but its balance changes before the final payment
The guest needs another tender or an updated amount
The second tender fails after part of the order is paid by gift card
The operator must reconcile both payments and the order

NODES.t: Transfer the balance to another card
NODES.d: At POS, transfer the remaining value of a funded migrated card to blank physical stock or to a newly issued digital card. For a digital transfer, confirm the recipient and delivery method. Native active cards use the separate reload or merge flows.
e: Migrated card not found because it was uploaded under another location or with a changed number
Old card deducted but the new load fails and the reversal also fails
Staff try to merge a migrated card instead of transferring its remaining balance
The merge is blocked until staff use the transfer flow
The recipient on a new digital card differs from the person the guest intended
The transfer succeeds but the intended recipient cannot access the value

NODES.d: Once the order is settled, the receipt records its tender breakdown. Card details and remaining balance depend on the receipt type and the data returned. Check eligible loyalty earnings separately from the face value of a gift card purchase.
e: A gift card purchase is incorrectly counted as a qualifying order as well as the later restaurant purchase
The guest earns points twice for the same spend
Online receipt shows the card's initial amount instead of the amount used
Guest confused about what was spent
Receipt shows the wrong card or none when several cards were applied

NODES.t: Refund an order paid by gift card
NODES.d: Staff refund the gift card payment on a ticket in full or in part. The refund is limited to the amount paid (with a 3 cent rounding allowance).
e: The original gift card is no longer accessible when a refund is returned to it
The guest needs help accessing the refunded value
Partial refunds across split tenders allocated to the wrong tender
Value returned to the wrong place
A refund proceeds outside the restaurant's configured permissions
The restaurant must investigate an unauthorised refund

NODES.t: Value loaded back to the card
NODES.d: The refund amount is loaded back onto the card on eCard Systems, the balance is re-read and saved, then the payment and ticket refund status, loyalty adjustment and refund record are saved.
e: Load succeeds but saving the refund fails; staff retry and the card is credited twice
The amount credited to the card exceeds the authorised refund including any eligible tax or tip
Partial refunds to gift cards are added back to Outstanding while full refunds are not

NODES.d: From Check balance/Reload the guest picks a reload amount and pays by card through Adyen with a one-hour token.
e: Reload amount is not checked against the maximum on the server
A reload is accepted for an unverified card relationship

NODES.d: A successful online reload adds funds with the provider and records a reload on the gift card ticket and ledger. Keep the underlying movement distinct when reconciling the Purchased total.
e: AIO balance increased before the eCard load; a failed load leaves AIO showing money the card does not have
A reload is read as a newly issued card sale in the combined Purchased total
The restaurant overstates new card sales

NODES.t: Request a gift card purchase refund
NODES.d: On POS, open the original gift card ticket, select refundable purchase items, review the total and enter a reason. Items marked ineligible cannot be selected. The service excludes reloads and previously refunded items. Cash refunds require POS. MoM has a separate supported payment flow.
e: A purchase and a reload on the same ticket are treated as one refundable amount
Staff promise more than the eligible refund
A cash refund is attempted from MoM
The operator must use the appropriate POS workflow

NODES.d: Cards never expire and there is no inactivity, dormancy or escheatment handling. A zero-balance card is reported as expired on some lookups.
e: No unclaimed property reporting for long-dormant balances
Guest thinks the card was voided
Restaurant churns with outstanding balances and no wind-down process

NODES.d: For the selected restaurant and closeout period, Purchased includes purchases, reloads and purchase refunds. Redeemed includes redemption reversals. Unclaimed is purchased less redeemed plus imported balance. An unfiltered date range is all time.
e: Purchase and Outstanding disagree with gift card records and the sales report
Operator cannot trust the liability figure
Outstanding is computed for the selected window, not as a running liability since launch
The operator compares one location with a business-wide report
An otherwise correct total looks incomplete
A purchase refund and a redemption reversal are reconciled as the same event
Purchased and redeemed appear to move in the wrong direction

NODES.t: Find a card in Card Summary
NODES.d: Filter digital or physical cards and search by full number. Compare the original amount, balance and latest activity. The guest profile provides the card activity detail. A list request failure has a separate Retry action from an empty result.
e: Search only matches the full card number; no search by guest, email, phone or last four digits
Date filter uses last update, so cards jump in and out of the range on each balance check
A historical card has a balance but an incomplete activity record
Support cannot explain the full movement from the opening balance
Balance column shows the AIO copy, not the eCard balance

NODES.d: In a restaurant guest profile, self-purchased cards belong to their buyer. A gift appears for its recipient after linking. Open the card activity and its available ticket or receipt details. The original purchase and its later refund have separate entries.
e: A guest record displays a card number without the required masking
Physical cards sold on POS sit under a placeholder guest and never appear on the real guest
A gifted card is checked under its purchaser before the recipient links it
Support concludes the card is missing

NODES.d: Gift card sales and redemptions should agree between the Gift Cards overview, the Merchant and sales reports, Adyen payouts and the eCard Systems statement.
e: Online gift card purchases missing from the Merchant report because the payment row has no card link and no ticket, so the restaurant filter drops it
Duplicate gift card ticket rows count one sale twice
Gift card redemptions counted as sales and the gift card purchase also counted as sales
No report reconciling AIO balances against the eCard Systems statement

NODES.d: The operator has the period's gift card sales, redemptions and outstanding liability for accounting.

POS shows the refundable amount returned for each card and totals the selected eligible items. The payment service limits refunds to the eligible paid share and remaining value. A later reload or merge can affect eligibility.
e: Staff quote face value on a discounted or partially spent card
The guest expects a larger refund
An eligible purchase is confused with an already refunded item
Staff cannot reconcile the remaining amount

NODES.d: Wait for the tender outcome. A card refund can remain pending until provider or terminal confirmation. An uncertain outcome needs review. Completed returns appear separately from the original purchase in card activity.
e: A pending card refund is reported as completed
The guest expects funds before confirmation
A provider outcome is uncertain after card value has changed
The operator must reconcile the card and the payout before another attempt

NODES.t: Merge balances onto one gift card
NODES.d: At POS, choose one funded destination card and up to four other distinct funded cards. Migrated cards use transfer instead. The merge screen limits the combined value to $10,000. Recheck the destination and source balances after completion.
e: The operator expects an empty or inventory card to contribute value
The destination balance and source activity disagree after an interrupted merge
Support must reconcile the participating cards

NODES.t: Sell a digital gift card at POS
NODES.d: Start a dedicated digital gift card sale, select an amount, enter and review the recipient and email or text delivery details, then pay. Check the paid ticket and recipient delivery separately.
e: A physical item or reload is already on the ticket
The digital sale needs a separate ticket
The card is funded but its delivery details are incorrect
The intended recipient cannot find the purchased card

NODES.d: Open transaction history in the online gift card view. Load more entries and check the date, amount, status and channel where available. A refunded card has its own handling on balance and reload screens.
e: The guest only checks the first page of activity
An earlier purchase or redemption appears missing
A refunded card is presented as available to reload
The guest expects a payment to succeed

NODES.t: Settle the Kiosk gift card payment
NODES.d: Confirm the final amount against the cart. For a mixed payment, follow the second tender to completion. Check the resulting payment and ticket before closing the order.
e: The gift card debit succeeds while the second payment is interrupted
The ticket and card need reconciliation
A delayed confirmation is displayed as a failed order

EDGES: Incorrect PIN, retry on the same card

PATHS.t: Buy a digital gift, sent now
PATHS.n: Baseline: set-up, online purchase for someone else, email sent at once, recipient links and spends online, operator reads the figures.

NOTES: eCard Systems (SmartTrack SOAP gateway) is the system of record for every balance; AIO stores a copy that is refreshed on lookups. Most money risks come from eCard calls made outside the database transaction.

Android POS internal d2b5329 confirms the register and customer display flows for purchase, lookup, transfer, merge, PIN, payment, tips and purchase refund selection. PROD-5111 and PROD-5099 remain historical field reports. Device reproduction, mPOS behaviour and provider settlement require separate evidence.
Kiosk has dedicated lookup, validation and payment services, including mixed tender. Device prompts, actual terminal behaviour and provider settlement still need an operational check.

Gift Cards and Guest Book display read-only activity. POS reads refundable amounts and eligibility per purchase item, then passes the selected items into the reason and tender flow. Verify MoM controls and final provider settlement separately.
